traits.name: Bonus Feat
traits.summary: Gain one additional feat at 1st level.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.summary: Gain one additional skill rank at every level.

alternateTraits.name: Eye for Talent
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +2 on Sense Motive checks. An acquired animal companion, bonded mount, cohort, or familiar gains +2 to one ability score of your choice.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Fields
alternateTraits.summary: Gain half your character level on one Craft or Profession skill and once per day ignore an effect that would cause fatigue or exhaustion.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Streets
alternateTraits.summary: Gain +1 Reflex and +1 dodge AC while adjacent to at least two allies, and crowds do not count as difficult terrain.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Wilderness
alternateTraits.summary: Gain half your character level on Survival, +5 on Constitution checks to stabilize, and add half your level to Constitution when determining the negative hit point total that kills you.
